compute_pl_loglikelihood_single: compute Plackett-Luce loglikelihood for a single instance with partial top-k rankings
compute_pl_loglikelihood_batch: compute Plackett-Luce loglikelihoods for a batch of partial orderings
compute_full_top_k_ordering: compute PL loglikelihood of a k-sized ordering within a larger L-sized set
compute_pl_loglikelihood_group: compute PL loglikelihood of a tied group within a larger ranking
compute_pl_loglikelihood_reader: compute PL loglikelihood for a single reader's partial ordering
